SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, A.* FROM ( SELECT M.DOC_ID, M.DOC_NO, M.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, M.FORM_CD, NVL(F.FORM_NM, CASE WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0701' THEN '휴가신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5101' THEN '출장신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5102' THEN '출장복명서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0801' THEN '휴일대체근무신청서' ELSE M.FORM_CD END) AS FORM_NM, M.DOC_TITLE, M.DOC_STATUS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.DOC_STATUS) AS DOC_STATUS_NM, M.DRA_USER_ID, M.DRA_USER_NM, M.DRA_DEPT_NM, M.DRA_LEVEL_NM, TO_CHAR(M.DRAFT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DRAFT_DT, M.CURR_LINE_SEQ, M.CURR_APPROVER_ID, M.CURR_APPROVER_NM, (SELECT LINE_TYPE FROM TB_AM11D01 WHERE DOC_ID = M.DOC_ID AND LINE_SEQ = M.CURR_LINE_SEQ) AS MY_LINE_TYPE, CASE WHEN M.CURR_APPROVER_ID != #{userId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DELEGATED FROM TB_AM11M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM02M01 F ON M.FORM_CD = F.FORM_CD WHERE M.DOC_STATUS IN ('REQUEST', 'PROGRESS') AND ( M.CURR_APPROVER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM11D01 P WHERE P.DOC_ID = M.DOC_ID AND P.LINE_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND P.APPROVER_ID = #{userId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM03M02 G WHERE G.ORIGIN_USER_ID = M.CURR_APPROVER_ID AND G.DELEGATE_USER_ID = #{userId} AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN G.START_DT AND G.END_DT ) )
ORDER BY M.DRAFT_DT ASC, M.DOC_ID ASC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastIndex} ) WHERE RN >= #{firstIndex}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, A.* FROM ( SELECT M.DOC_ID, M.DOC_NO, M.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, M.FORM_CD, NVL(F.FORM_NM, CASE WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0701' THEN '휴가신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5101' THEN '출장신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5102' THEN '출장복명서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0801' THEN '휴일대체근무신청서' ELSE M.FORM_CD END) AS FORM_NM, M.DOC_TITLE, M.DOC_STATUS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.DOC_STATUS) AS DOC_STATUS_NM, M.DRA_USER_ID, M.DRA_USER_NM, M.DRA_DEPT_NM, M.DRA_LEVEL_NM, TO_CHAR(M.DRAFT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DRAFT_DT, M.CURR_LINE_SEQ, M.CURR_APPROVER_ID, M.CURR_APPROVER_NM FROM TB_AM11M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM02M01 F ON M.FORM_CD = F.FORM_CD WHERE M.DOC_STATUS IN ('REQUEST', 'PROGRESS') AND ( M.DRA_USER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM11D01 D WHERE D.DOC_ID = M.DOC_ID AND D.APPROVER_ID = #{userId} ) )
ORDER BY M.DRAFT_DT DESC, M.DOC_ID DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastIndex} ) WHERE RN >= #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_AM11M01 M WHERE M.DRA_USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.DOC_STATUS != 'DRAFT'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, A.* FROM ( SELECT M.DOC_ID, M.DOC_NO, M.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, M.FORM_CD, NVL(F.FORM_NM, CASE WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0701' THEN '휴가신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5101' THEN '출장신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5102' THEN '출장복명서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0801' THEN '휴일대체근무신청서' ELSE M.FORM_CD END) AS FORM_NM, M.DOC_TITLE, M.DOC_STATUS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.DOC_STATUS) AS DOC_STATUS_NM, M.DRA_USER_ID, M.DRA_USER_NM, M.DRA_DEPT_NM, TO_CHAR(M.DRAFT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DRAFT_DT, TO_CHAR(M.COMPLETE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS COMPLETE_DT, M.CURR_APPROVER_NM FROM TB_AM11M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM02M01 F ON M.FORM_CD = F.FORM_CD WHERE M.DRA_USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.DOC_STATUS != 'DRAFT'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RN, A.* FROM ( SELECT M.DOC_ID, M.DOC_NO, M.CO_CD, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.CO_CD) AS CO_NM, M.FORM_CD, NVL(F.FORM_NM, CASE WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0701' THEN '휴가신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5101' THEN '출장신청서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM5102' THEN '출장복명서' WHEN M.FORM_CD = 'PM0801' THEN '휴일대체근무신청서' ELSE M.FORM_CD END) AS FORM_NM, M.DOC_TITLE, M.DOC_STATUS, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(M.DOC_STATUS) AS DOC_STATUS_NM, M.DRA_USER_ID, M.DRA_USER_NM, M.DRA_DEPT_NM, TO_CHAR(M.DRAFT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DRAFT_DT, TO_CHAR(M.COMPLETE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS COMPLETE_DT FROM TB_AM11M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM02M01 F ON M.FORM_CD = F.FORM_CD WHERE M.DOC_STATUS = 'REJECTED' AND ( M.DRA_USER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM11D01 D WHERE D.DOC_ID = M.DOC_ID AND D.APPROVER_ID = #{userId} ) )
ORDER BY M.COMPLETE_DT DESC, M.DOC_ID DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastIndex} ) WHERE RN >= #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_AM11M01 M WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_AM11D01 D WHERE D.DOC_ID = M.DOC_ID AND D.APPROVER_ID = #{userId} AND D.LINE_TYPE = 'REF' )
